drhp.business: Afcons Infrastructure Limited is a technology-driven engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contractor executing complex and large-scale infrastructure projects. The Company serves public and private clients across more than 30 countries in Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, with a portfolio spanning marine and industrial works, urban infrastructure (metros, bridges), surface transport (highways, railways), oil and gas (offshore/onshore), and hydro and underground projects.
